pages.text: Fertilized Essence $(bold)usually$() drops from all $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() $(bold)except Inferium$(). It works identically to Bonemeal, but also works on $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$()! $(br2)Fertilized Essence can also be used to more efficiently craft $(l:advances/mystical_fertilizer)Mystical Fertilizer$().
